List workflows
List active workflows in a workspace. Requires workspace read access.
GET
/api/v2/workflows
Use scope=archived to find workflows available for restoration. Filter by folder, deployment, or name; sort and page with the returned cursor.
Authentication
API key or OAuth bearer token. OAuth scope: api:read. Workspace folder trees exceeding 10,000 folders return 413.
Query parameters
workspaceId
string
Required
Workspace whose workflows should be listed.
scope
enum
Default: active
active or archived. Archived-folder filtering can return an empty page.
folderPath
FolderPathInput
Optional
Restrict results to this folder path.
deployedOnly
boolean
Optional
Return only workflows with an active deployment.
limit
integer
Default: 50
Whole number from 1 to 100.
cursor
string
Optional
Cursor from the previous page. Keep the same sort and filters; only limit may change.
search
string
Optional
Case-insensitive substring match against the resource name.
sortBy
enum
Default: position
position, name, createdAt, updatedAt, or runCount.
sortOrder
enum
Default: asc
asc or desc.
Response
200
A page of workflows.
data contains the workflows. Use nextCursor to fetch the next page. Rate-limit headers accompany the response.

cURL
